summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing B3's approval of its migration to the Novo Mercado listing segment, triggering a mandatory exchange of all Class B1 preferred shares and ADSs into common shares/ADSs at a 1.1:1 ratio, effective June 10, 2026. Cash is provided for fractional ADSs. The filing focuses on U.S. federal income tax consequences for U.S. holders of Class B1 preferred ADSs. This is a corporate restructuring (share-class unification) to comply with Novo Mercado governance rules, not a traditional special situation. No deal terms, premium, or advisor are stated. Watch for future filings on exchange mechanics and tax rulings.
